---
- name: Configure node1 as DHCP server for the private eth1 network
  hosts: dhcp_server
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    dhcp_iface: eth1
    dhcp_server_addr: 10.50.50.1
    dhcp_subnet: 10.50.50.0/24
    dhcp_range_start: 10.50.50.100
    dhcp_range_stop: 10.50.50.200
  tasks:
    - name: Apply VyOS interface address and DHCP server configuration
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
        configure
        set interfaces ethernet {{ dhcp_iface }} address {{ dhcp_server_addr }}/24
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet {{ dhcp_subnet }} subnet-id 1
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet {{ dhcp_subnet }} range 0 start {{ dhcp_range_start }}
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet {{ dhcp_subnet }} range 0 stop {{ dhcp_range_stop }}
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet {{ dhcp_subnet }} option default-router {{ dhcp_server_addr }}
        commit
        save
        exit
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: vyos_apply
      changed_when: "'No configuration changes to commit' not in vyos_apply.stdout"
      failed_when: >
        vyos_apply.rc != 0 or
        ('command not found' in vyos_apply.stdout) or
        ('Set failed' in vyos_apply.stdout) or
        ('Commit failed' in vyos_apply.stdout)

    - name: Verify DHCP server configuration is present
      ansible.builtin.command: cat /config/config.boot
      register: vyos_verify
      changed_when: false

    - name: Assert DHCP server config was committed
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - "'dhcp-server' in vyos_verify.stdout"
          - "'10.50.50.0/24' in vyos_verify.stdout"

- name: Configure node2/node3 to obtain their private-network address via DHCP
  hosts: dhcp_clients
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  vars:
    dhcp_iface: eth1
    dhcp_connection: "Wired connection 2"
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure the private-network connection uses DHCP (not a static assignment)
      community.general.nmcli:
        conn_name: "{{ dhcp_connection }}"
        ifname: "{{ dhcp_iface }}"
        type: ethernet
        method4: auto
        autoconnect: true
        state: present
      register: nm_result

    - name: Re-activate the connection to pick up a lease
      ansible.builtin.command: nmcli connection up "{{ dhcp_connection }}"
      when: nm_result is changed

    - name: Wait for a DHCP-leased address on the private interface
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        set -e
        ip -4 -o addr show dev {{ dhcp_iface }} | awk '{print $4}'
      register: iface_addr
      until: iface_addr.stdout is search('10\.50\.50\.')
      retries: 10
      delay: 3
      changed_when: false

    - name: Report leased address
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ inventory_hostname }} leased {{ iface_addr.stdout }} on {{ dhcp_iface }}"
